# Security measures

<!-- Generated by scripts/export-security-measures.js from src/config/securityPosture.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

IDevelop Community Edition documents **44 security controls** in 5 areas. Each one cites the code that implements it and the automated tests that prove it. The same list is shown in the application under **About → Security**.

A test (`tests/unit/securityPostureEvidence.test.js`) fails if a cited file or test disappears, so this page cannot claim a control the code no longer has.

## Standards and frameworks

The controls are mapped to the standards below. **This is a self-assessment by the development team, not a certification.** OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 level 2 was verified requirement by requirement: 258 requirements, **166 pass** and **18 fixed** during the assessment, 38 partial, 2 open gaps, 29 not applicable and 5 not verifiable from the code (`docs/ASVS-L2.md`). The other frameworks are mapped control by control in `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md`, which also lists what the deploying organisation must still do.

| Framework                                | Basis         | Details                      |
| ---------------------------------------- | ------------- | ---------------------------- |
| OWASP ASVS 4.0.3 — Level 2               | self-assessed | `docs/ASVS-L2.md`            |
| OWASP Top 10 (2021)                      | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| CWE Top 25 (2024)                        | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A               | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| SOC 2 (CC6, CC7, CC8)                    | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| GDPR (Articles 5, 15–17, 25, 30, 32, 35) | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| EU AI Act (Articles 13, 14)              | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |
| NIST SSDF (SP 800-218)                   | mapped        | `docs/COMPLIANCE-MAPPING.md` |

## Running the security tests

```bash
npm test                                   # the whole suite, as CI runs it
npx jest tests/unit/webSecurityBaseline.test.js tests/unit/securityControls.test.js tests/unit/securityPostureEvidence.test.js
npm audit --omit=dev                       # known vulnerabilities in dependencies
```

## Known limitations

- The CSP still allows inline event handlers (`script-src-attr 'unsafe-inline'`) and inline styles; inline `<script>` blocks need the per-request nonce. Moving the remaining `onclick=` handlers to scripts is planned.
- Without `APP_KEY` or `SESSION_SECRET` (development only), stored secrets are kept in clear; production refuses to start without a strong secret.
- No independent penetration test has been published yet. One is recommended before general availability; see `docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md` for the internal audit and `SECURITY.md` for reporting a vulnerability.
